Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Talbot Hardwood Double Sunlounger
Adjustable, all-weather outdoor lounge chair built for 2 to enjoy at the same time Shorea hardwood with dark stain finish; stainless-steel hardware; mortise and tenon joints 2 rear 8-inch wheels for mobility; 2 side trays for drinks, snacks, books, or whatever Independently adjustable back and leg rests each have 3 positions Fully upright: 72-1/2 inches long by 52-1/4 inches wide by 33-1/2 inches high
